lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical line segments. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming slightly denser toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single bifurcation is visible on the 5th line from the posterior, where the line splits in the upper third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three lines on the anterior torso terminate before reaching the ventral margin; one line on the posterior flank is fractured into three distinct vertical segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, centered vertically above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper-rear haunch align to form a short horizontal geometric vector.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; large white patch at the base of the throat; dark pigmentation on lower limbs above the hooves.
